summary: Round 39 recheck, 11:10-11:25Z 29 Sep (14:10-14:25 MSK), before the 11:50Z slot-2 message. Sources: local files, three local CPU computations, 0 Kaggle calls, no browser. The lens is saturated (~143 earlier items, and the round-38 carry-over list). I picked three closed items that the 12:00Z slot-2 decision and the 20:00Z finals tick still depend on, each with a fresh check. (A) exp86c (READMIT 0.92 on the K base, non-CI, dummy PASSED 28 Sep, excluded at 12:23Z as public fit) as the slot-2 file, now that the slot's default is UNUSED: UPHELD, with a new reason. Its dummy lab is -0.0001 vs exp85a (identical TP/FP/FN, so the node term only). P(display >= 0.960) is 0.01-0.08. Its only live branch (>= 0.960) would make a non-CI public-fit file V_pub in place of the CI champion, and the private delta of that swap is ~RA92 - CI ~ -0.0005. So sending it has <= 0 value, and UNUSED stands. (B) v2's dropped 'division cap for private J' (the lab marginal beyond cap 4 is 0 TP / +2 FP; the exp60 lab puts cap 6 at -0.00057), which the public cap-6 read (probe 45) overrode for V_pub: REVIVED AS A PRIOR ONLY. I re-ran mc26 with a cap-6 prior of -0.0006 / 0 / +0.0004 (12 runs, 2 seeds). Cap-6 partners (exp79a, exp85a) are below both cap-4 partners in every run: at -0.0006, bronze is 0.63-0.69 vs 0.75-0.77. P2 {exp87a, exp75} >= P3 on silver in 12/12 runs; on bronze P3 is ahead in 5/12, by <= 0.011. The pair logic (cap-4 partner) is right; no change. The still-ticked {#37, #38} scores bronze 0.49 / silver 0.11 in every run, which supports the card v3 line 'tick now'. (C) Tie rule: the KEY FACTS say 'ties broken by the EARLIER submission', and R38 wrote that Fanch 'ranks above us on the earlier timestamp'. Both are WRONG for display ties. v4's unrounded-order finding is re-confirmed with today's rows: Fanch's 0.959 was submitted at 03:20:41Z on 29 Sep, 15 h after exp87a, and ranks above us; Manish's 04:13:52Z file ranks below us. This validates the UP test in the exp89t T3 playbook. I-542 (re-submit for tie order) stays refuted. No build, no dummy, no slot, no rule change.
